summary: Short clip in which Nick Huber tells a story from his book: in 2015, with about $600k of cash saved and a self-storage development underway, his mentor Jim, a DC wealth manager, gave him a free one-hour review of his entire financial life. Jim flagged bonus depreciation and cost segregation (a $600-700k tax write-off), key man insurance and buy-sell planning, and C Corp vs S Corp tax choices, then refused to invoice. Jim explained he does this free for all prospective clients, who are high-value business owners, and 30-40% sign up on the spot while the rest return later. Takeaway: lead with free expert value to build trust with high-value prospects, but this does not suit every sales environment.

tactics.name: Free high-value first meeting for high-value prospects
steps: Spend one hour breaking down the prospect's whole situation
Unload as much expert value as possible on a whiteboard
Give handouts and a photo of the action list
Don't invoice, talk money or pitch
Expect 30-40% to sign immediately and many others to return when the next problem arises
